sloka: प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीम् राम कीर्तिम् स बहु वार्षिकीम् ।ब्रह्मणः स्थानम् आसाद्य तत्र च अपि महीयते ॥३-६-१३॥
transliteration: prāpnoti śāśvatīm rāma kīrtim sa bahu vārṣikīm ।brahmaṇaḥ sthānam āsādya tatra ca api mahīyate ॥3-6-13॥

translations.english: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity thereafter.
translations.hindi: वह राजा, इस लोक में बहुबएब्यापिनी स्थायी कीर्ति प्राप्त फर, अन्त में ब्रह्मलोक में जा, विशेष सम्मान का पात्र बनता है
